successCriteria.description: src/shared/types/index.ts exports enum LeaveType with exactly three members: ANNUAL, SICK, EMERGENCY (string-valued)
src/shared/types/index.ts exports enum LeaveRequestStatus with exactly five members: DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED (string-valued)
src/shared/types/index.ts exports enum EmploymentStatus with exactly four members: ACTIVE, INACTIVE, TERMINATED, ON_LEAVE (string-valued)
tests/unit/shared/types/types.test.ts contains Jest tests verifying each enum has the correct members and correct member count
All tests pass when run with Jest (npx jest tests/unit/shared/types/types.test.ts)

constraints: Enums must use string values (e.g., ANNUAL = 'ANNUAL'), not numeric — consistent with the existing codebase pattern
File must be at src/shared/types/index.ts — the canonical shared types entry point referenced by all downstream domain modules
Tests must be at tests/unit/shared/types/types.test.ts and must verify both member values and member count for each enum
Must comply with HARNESS.json constraint no-any: no use of `any` type
outOfScope: No other types, interfaces, utility functions, or constants beyond the three enums (LeaveType, LeaveRequestStatus, EmploymentStatus)
No database migrations, repository code, service logic, controllers, or routes — those are deferred to Phases 2–9
No integration or e2e tests — only unit tests for enum verification
